title: BillingVibesWallet
description: billing.vibes-wallet@1: a person's own Vibes, answered by GET /api/v1/vibes/me (capability billing.vibes.read) to an app the person approved. credit is Vibes to spend; payable is Vibes the person received as a creator and may cash out under the payout rules (never into Balance); bits_per_usd is today's rate. Vibes are whole integers; this is not a Balance and carries no nano-USD.

subject.description: The person the app reads for (the approved delegation). Only a user, never an app or a service.

payable.description: Vibes received as a creator, to cash out; never Balance.

bits_per_usd.description: Today's Vibes per USD rate, the same one a pack is priced with.
